scene: The red moon gate hums softly with spinning neon dragon runes.
picture: A flat side-scrolling view of the circular red moon gate. On the left, glowing blue dragon runes pulse on the gate's frame. In the centre stands the broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man in a floral shirt and sandals, holding his ukulele. Up high rests a bamboo ladder against the arch, while a stone lion sits on the far right.
shown: a bright blue neon carved rune on the moon gate on the left
a tall bamboo ladder leaning against the gate arch up high
a smiling stone lion statue sitting patiently on the far right
